description:
Projects tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- list_folders: List Asset Library folders (projects) you can see, scoped to the active workspace when one is selected.
- create_folder: Create a library folder (project), optionally inside parent_id.
- update_folder: Rename a library folder (name) and/or move it under another folder (parent_id; null = top level).
- delete_folder: Delete a library folder AND its subfolders.
- update_asset_folder: File up to 50 Asset Library items into a folder (folder_id), or unfile them (folder_id null).
- list_explore: Browse the public Explore feed: screened community creations (filter by kind, studio or contest slug) or, with type:'projects', published pr
- list_contests: The weekly creator contests with their status from the database clock (upcoming / open / judging / closed), allowed kinds (image, video), cl
- create_contest_entry: Enter one of YOUR library images in an open contest: it is shared publicly to Explore, tagged with the contest.
- get_project_page: Whether a library folder is published as a public project page (/p/<slug>): slug, title, published/hidden state, item count and URL.
- update_project_page: Change the title and/or brief of your public project page (/p/<slug>).
- unpublish_project: Take your public project page (/p/<slug>) offline.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).
